Q-7281: How many days are there from 2023-11-24 to 2024-05-31 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 189 days.

Calculation: Nov 25–30 = 6, Dec = 31, Jan = 31, Feb = 29 (2024 leap year), Mar = 31, Apr = 30, May = 31. Total = 6+31+31+29+31+30+31 = 189.
